versions.changelog: P1: rewrite install-conversion summary and standardize legal disclaimer.
Fix display name and keep metadata runtime-neutral.

**Summary:** Added Python handler for local contract risk detection; enhanced metadata with tags.

- New `handler.py` file added to handle local contract risk analysis logic.
- Added tags to skill metadata for improved discoverability.
- No external integrations; local pattern matching remains.
- Documentation updated to reflect new tags, functionality unchanged for end users.

**Major update: clearer prompts, improved risk pattern details, and streamlined local analysis workflow.**

- Fully rewrote and expanded documentation, now primarily in Chinese with bilingual sample prompts and outputs
- Included sample prompts for Chinese employment, English service, and NDA contracts with clear risk scan illustrations
- Simplified the feature description: supports local scanning of common contract risks in both Chinese and English, no content upload
- Detailed supported risk clause categories, output formats, and clean local operation principles
- Removed deprecated code/scripts; updated test files for new workflow and formats
Initial release. Read-only local pattern scan for contract risk clauses. No exec, no network, no credential access.

Initial release of the contract-risk-helper skill.

- Introduced an auto-update tool for managing OpenClaw skill updates.
- Provides safe update features: version checking, automatic local backups, and rollback support.
- Includes configuration management (blacklist, auto-upgrade strategies, quiet hours).
- Only reads local files; all actual updates are executed via the clawhub CLI.
- Easy management of backups, cache, and update strategies through simple command-line commands.
